kākola.p: [Kāka+ula] (pu) CL=7 [Kā ko viya ulati gacchatīti kākolo, ḷattaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 639.] (1) A crow. See - Kākolasaṅgha. (2) A black crow. See - Kākolagaṇa. (3) A rook (bird).
pn: Kākola. A hell; beings born there are dragged about by flocks of ravens, vultures and hawks, and eaten alive. Ja.vi.247.
